postTitle: Any tips for future game creators?
postSubject: I want to creat a game,  but I dont know how, is there any game creators that would give me tips, any tips are appreciated.
commentSubject: Yes, I do have some tips. :)First, make sure you know what kind of games you want to make before committing to learn an engine. I know a lot of people started learning Clickteam Fusion because of FNaF, but if you want to create 3d games then I'd recommend Unity or UDK. Both are free to use and are great engines.Second, learn to code! There are many engines that use code, and many that do not, but learning to code is a great skill that goes beyond game design. There are a limited number of jobs for game design, but if you know how to code, then you can get a job in the game industry or almost anywhere else. Unity uses Javascript, which is a great language and pretty easy to use for simple things.I really think those are the two most important things to mention for beginners!
